checks.name: Initialization requires the deployed program upgrade authority; failed initialization leaves no Config or collection
Collection created by real Core CPI and update authority is the Config PDA
Edition cap is fixed at creation
Issuer and recipient signed claims mint actual Core assets with only immutable ImmutableMetadata and AddBlocker plugins
Sold-out claim rolls back asset, record and receipt creation, preserving issued count
Claim receipt prevents replay across wallets and editions
Checkpoint requires current owner and enforces sequence and irreversible growth branch
Swap listing transfers actual Core ownership from maker to Offer PDA escrow
Two completed Core swap CPIs roll back together after a later instruction fails
checks.scope: transaction atomicity after both CPIs; does not claim a forced second-CPI failure

checks.name: Two-wallet swap changes both actual owners and closes escrow; maker signature not needed at acceptance
Changed desired-pet checkpoint invalidates swap quote and maker can recover escrow
Market reader verifies actual finalized escrow, chain Clock, pet traits and original fee snapshot
Insufficient fee funds roll back prior seller payment and preserve asset escrow and offer
Sale settles atomically with floor-rounded fee deducted from gross; listing retains its fee snapshot
Maker can recover actual escrowed asset while paused; no platform cancellation fee
Closed offer addresses cannot be replayed because nonce increases monotonically
